idea: baseline labeler: deepseek-v4.1-flash, task spec only, 20 seeds (all negative), soft labels
takeaway: reference labeler; seeds contain 0 positives so they only teach negatives

idea: labeling guidance v1: ToxicChat convention (sexual requests, harmful how-to, hate jokes, jailbreak role-play count as toxic; neutral sensitive topics do not)
takeaway: explicit ToxicChat convention lifts labeler toxic F1 by +0.08

idea: guidance v2: + intent rule (benign overrides/personas are neither toxic nor jailbreak; vulgar slang counts)
takeaway: toxic -1 example (noise), jailbreak +0.14; kept v2 for its jailbreak gain

idea: guidance v1 without the 20 seed examples
takeaway: all-negative seeds neither help nor hurt; 3x cheaper prompt

idea: labeler comparison with guidance v2: claude-haiku-5.5, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, qwen3.7-flash
takeaway: no labeler clearly better; qwen3.7-flash ties best at lowest cost; haiku 7x cost, no gain

idea: labeler ensemble (mean of soft labels): deepseek g2 + qwen g2
takeaway: averaging two cheap labelers gives graded labels and the best dev F1; adding haiku/gemini raised AUC (0.99) but not F1

idea: label full pool (4862) with deepseek g2 + qwen g2 soft labels
takeaway: 373/349 toxic (7.7%/7.2%), 317 agree; 86 borderline; labeling ran ~1 call/s due to shared OpenRouter load

idea: gte-modernbert shared encoder, two sigmoid heads, ONNX fp32 vs dynamic int8
takeaway: fp32 misses the gate; full int8 passes but drifts (toxic bestF1 0.788->0.750)

idea: selective int8: keep mlp/Wo (GeGLU output projection) in fp32
takeaway: mlp/Wo activation outliers cause the int8 drift; excluding them restores fp32 accuracy at ~+10 ms p95 (busy machine); no single layer dominates

idea: student baseline on v1 silver_seeded hard labels (shared encoder, 2 heads, gte-modernbert full FT)
takeaway: ranking good (AUC .98) but threshold-unstable; best threshold 0.1

idea: student on new 2-labeler soft labels (dsqw)
change: labels v1 hard -> ds+qwen g2 soft
takeaway: within dev noise; misses short crude/hateful prompts

idea: synthetic positives (374, steered by pool prompts both labelers flagged, relabeled by ensemble)
takeaway: F1@0.5 up, AP slightly up, cvF1 within noise

idea: pos_weight 3 on both heads (+synth)
takeaway: no clear gain

idea: student on v1 silver plain+seeded averaged (soft)
takeaway: best AP but threshold low (0.05)

idea: +287 short crude/hateful synthetic positives +376 hard negatives (benign personas, benign overrides, sensitive educational)
takeaway: small, within-noise improvement

idea: GPU scheduler deadlock killed two runs (v1ens, dsqw); OOM on shared GPUs
change: added grad checkpointing, bs8x2 accumulation, OOM retry
takeaway: infrastructure; reran in new processes

idea: 4-labeler soft ensemble for student: ds g2 + qwen g2 + v1 silver_seeded + v1 silver
takeaway: no gain over 2 labelers; seed-to-seed spread of dev cvF1 is ~0.1 so single runs cannot be ranked

idea: 4-labeler ensemble without synth
takeaway: synthetic data adds ~+0.02 AP consistently (all4, dsqw)

idea: seed repeat dsqw_syn3 seed 1
takeaway: dev noise across seeds ~0.03 cvF1 for this config

idea: batched labeling: 10 prompts per request, same guidance v2 + seeds, soft answers
takeaway: batching is 2-4x cheaper with equal or better agreement (jailbreak improved, maybe from cross-prompt contrast); gpt-5.6-luna poor; deepseek-v4-pro blocked by the client max_price routing cap

idea: batched labeler ensembles on dev
takeaway: labeler ceiling ~0.88-0.91 toxic F1 on dev regardless of combo; haiku adds ranking diversity (AUC .957->.984)

idea: 3 seeds of dsqw+synth3 (sA_s0/1/2), and oversampling positives x3
takeaway: same seed is not reproducible on shared GPUs (bf16); single-run dev spread 0.68-0.80 cvF1

idea: model soup: uniform weight average of the 3 seed models (same init)
takeaway: weight soup beats every member and the probability ensemble at zero latency cost

idea: haiku-5.5 batched (bs=10) labels on whole pool as third labeler
takeaway: 1 missing; used as 3rd soft-label source

idea: second synthetic round: 669 positives (all subtopics) + 480 hard negatives
takeaway: generated; evaluated in next student round

idea: config B: 3-labeler soft labels (ds g2 + qwen g2 + haiku batched) + all synth (1,323 pos, 856 hard neg), 4 seeds + soup
takeaway: members no better than config A; soup again lifts cvF1 by ~0.08 over the mean member

idea: soup of all 7 fine-tunes (A x3 + B x3+1)
takeaway: ties soupA/soupB on dev (paired bootstrap CI includes 0); chosen for averaging the most seeds

idea: threshold rule: bootstrap-mean F1 curve on dev, further averaged over a +-0.05 threshold window, argmax
takeaway: raw dev argmax sits on a cliff (3 positives between 0.35 and 0.40); smoothing picks a plateau; gold-optimal threshold is lower than silver-optimal (gold has subtler positives)

idea: soupAB selective int8 (mlp/Wo fp32) dev check
takeaway: no dev loss from quantisation; p95 61 ms (4 threads, load ~3.5)

idea: round 1 frozen: soupAB int8, thresholds toxic 0.35 / jailbreak 0.60, scored once with final_eval
takeaway: see final.json for test (not logged here)

idea: max_len 512 -> 256/192 by truncation only (round-1 soupAB int8)
takeaway: p95 is set by ~180-token prompts, which max_len 256 does not touch; truncation alone barely moves p95 and costs one dev positive

idea: export with eager attention instead of SDPA
takeaway: SDPA export adds IsNaN/Where masking per layer (~15-18% of CPU time); eager export is numerically identical and faster

idea: onnxruntime.transformers optimizer (SkipLayerNorm fusion, bert type, no attention fusion)
takeaway: slower on this graph; dropped

idea: SmoothQuant on mlp/Wo (fold per-channel scale into gate half of Wi), then full int8 incl. mlp/Wo
takeaway: smoothing removes the mlp/Wo outlier problem; full int8 now matches the fp32-Wo model on dev

idea: eager + SmoothQuant full int8 (soupAB_sq0.75), max_len 512
takeaway: ~25-30% lower p95 at the same dev accuracy; max_len 384 identical on dev, 256 loses ~1 positive

idea: bigger shared-init soup: 6 more seeds (A s3-5, B s4-6) -> 13-model uniform soup
takeaway: no dev gain from a bigger soup (slightly worse, within noise); kept the 7-model soup

idea: round 2 frozen: round-1 soupAB weights, eager export + SmoothQuant(0.75) full int8, max_len 512; thresholds re-chosen by the same smoothed-bootstrap rule on its int8 dev probs
takeaway: latency fix with unchanged dev accuracy; justifies one rerun

idea: stronger labeler probes on dev (batched bs10/20, guidance v2, no seeds)
change: deepseek-v4-pro reasoning medium; gemini-3-flash-preview reasoning low; claude-sonnet-5.5 reasoning max 1024 tokens
takeaway: no single strong labeler beats the cheap ds+qwen ensemble on F1; sonnet gives the best graded ranking (AP .88) and averaging it in gives +1 dev example (within noise). sonnet requires reasoning on OpenRouter (400 if disabled)

idea: relabel 498 uncertain pool prompts with claude-sonnet-5.5 (any labeler>=0.3, student-label diff>0.3, student>=0.2)
takeaway: 4 of 25 batches failed (reasoning ate the token budget), and the per-item retries re-sent the system prompt 80 times ($0.23); in-flight concurrency took scope spend to $1.78, over the $1.64 cap. Sonnet flips 100 of 400 base positives to negative and 5 negatives to positive

idea: LLM budget overshoot note
takeaway: library race: concurrent in-flight sonnet calls each passed the budget check; library now reserves in-flight cost. No further LLM calls made after this

idea: students on sonnet-combined labels (toxic soft = mean(mean(ds,qwen), sonnet) on 494 relabeled prompts; 344 vs 373 hard positives), 3 seeds x {synth3, synth5}
takeaway: member AP up slightly (mean .867 vs ~.855 for rounds 1-2), F1 not

idea: round-3 candidates vs round-2 frozen (all SmoothQuant int8, smoothed-bootstrap thresholds)
takeaway: no dev gain beyond noise on F1, CV or AP, so no third test look; round 2 stays frozen

idea: 2-model prediction ensemble: mean of soupAB_sq (round 2) and soupCD_sq (round-3 sonnet labels) int8 probs
takeaway: no dev gain; the 13-model weight soup (round 3) already captured the same diversity

idea: ModernBERT-large (395M) two-head int8 (eager + full int8), max_len 512, 8 threads
takeaway: large is ~4x the 150M model at ~180-token prompts; far over the gate even allowing for machine load; not trained

idea: post-hoc calibration
change: per-head temperature scaling fitted on deployed int8 dev probs (toxic T=0.515, jailbreak T=0.435)
takeaway: Deployed model is underconfident; T<1 cuts test ECE toxic 0.061->0.004, jailbreak 0.079->0.005 (Jev raw 0.015/0.031). Isotonic overfits with 16/7 positives.
